resources.string: Start with your music. Add songs from your phone, or connect a library you already use.
Scan your device or select a music folder. ECHO asks for access when you need it.
Add a NAS or music server from the library page.
Your current song stays within reach while you browse your library.
Tap the bottom player to see artwork, playback controls and your queue.
Open lyrics in the player. Local lyrics are supported; online lyrics can be enabled in settings.
Connect your phone to ECHOSteam on your computer over the same local network.
Open Echo Link on your computer, then use the Connect page on your phone to pair and browse its library.
Set it up whenever you like
You can listen to local music now and connect a computer later.
